title: Pest Control Service
author: Pest Control Service
description:
In this episode we walk through a full pest inspection before you sign the papers for a Huntington Beach home. A home can look clean and still hide termites in the wood. A home can smell fresh and still hide rats in the attic. The inspector starts outside the house and checks the roofline and the vents and the soil. The inspector climbs into the attic and reads the droppings and the frass like a map. The inspector checks the kitchen and the bathrooms for drips and drains and damp walls. The inspector brings a moisture meter and a borescope and an acoustic listener to find what a walk through misses. The inspection ends with a written report that lists every risk by room with photos. To learn about professional pest inspection in Huntington Beach listen to the full episode and book the inspection before you sign. A termite risk means a treatment plan. A rat risk means a seal and trap plan. A roach risk means a bait and clean plan. You can see the full inspection plan here: https://pestcontrolhuntingtonbeachca.com/services/pest-inspection/ A buyer who reads the report can ask the seller to fix the risks. For local help contact Pest Control Huntington Beach CA to book a pest inspection. Call (714) 202-6531 from 7am to 8pm. The office sits at 7755 Center Ave Suite 1100 in Huntington Beach CA 92647.
https://pestcontrolhuntingtonbeachca.com/

title: Lord Jim (A Journey of Redemption)

description:
Jim's moment of cowardice on a sinking ship haunts him, marking the beginning of a profound journey toward redemption in Joseph Conrad's "Lord Jim." As he grapples with his shattered reputation, Jim seeks the approval of the world and, more importantly, himself. Marlow, a seasoned sea captain, becomes both mentor and confidant, guiding Jim through the turbulent waters of guilt, honor, and the quest for identity. Listeners will dive deep into the complexities of human nature, exploring themes of bravery and shame.

This audiobook unpacks the psychological turmoil of a young man caught between his aspirations and the weight of his failures. Conrad crafts a narrative rich with moral ambiguity, where every decision could lead to salvation or further disgrace. As Jim navigates his way through distant lands and encounters a cast of captivating characters, he must confront the truths of his past while striving to forge a new path.

What does it mean to be a hero? Can one moment define a life? "Lord Jim" invites listeners to ponder these questions as they accompany Jim on his quest for redemption. Join us on this gripping exploration of courage, identity, and the relentless search for forgiveness. With every twist and turn, this audiobook promises to keep you engaged until the very end.

description:
Taking sleeping pills but still waking up exhausted? Struggling with insomnia even after trying medications, supplements, and sleep studies? Seven or eight hours of sleep doesn’t always mean you’re getting the restorative sleep your brain needs.


I’m Nyree Penn, founder of NSOMNIA Sleep in South Florida. After twenty years practicing anesthesia, I explore the connection between anesthesia, brain activity, and sleep.


I break down insomnia, sleep medications, GABA, adenosine, brain health, and the science of falling asleep and staying asleep. You’ll learn why sleeping pills stop working over time, why you can sleep all night and still wake up tired, how insomnia and anxiety are linked, and how propofol, anesthesia-based approaches, and personalized sleep assessments may help.


Follow for straightforward conversations about chronic insomnia, sleep science, and emerging sleep treatments.


This Podcast is for educational purposes and does not replace individualized medical advice.

title: Cap Table

description: The valuation everyone’s celebrating might be quietly moving your ownership to the margins. Each case takes one real fundraising decision and works it through line by line: pre- and post-money math, how an option pool tweak changes outcomes, what a “headline” price really means once dilution is accounted for, and how the cap table evolves over time. Expect clear, stepwise walkthroughs that make sense of jargon and reveal the trade-offs founders accept when they pick one term set over another. It’s practical, spreadsheet-level storytelling that favors arithmetic over lore, helping builders understand where their shares go, what the percentages look like after the dust settles, and why small differences in a term sheet can compound into big changes in control and eventual payout.

title: The Hunt with Bethany Schneider

description:
The Hunt follows headline verdicts back to the career-defining calls that made ordinary trial lawyers legends.
We know the verdicts. We know the names. But how did they get the case?

Trial lawyer Bethany Schneider is hunting for her first eight-figure case, going straight to the lawyers who’ve already gotten those big wins—not to ask only how they won, but also to go a step further and find out how they got their blockbuster case in the first place.

Each episode traces a landmark verdict back through the relationships, reputation, referrals, risks, wins and losses that put a lawyer in position to be the one who gets the call for the case that changed everything—then goes inside the trial to see how they built it and won it.

It's a resource for anyone interested in referrals, jury trial wins, and civil litigation strategy, from plaintiff lawyers and personal injury attorneys to those still building their way there.
Part origin story, part trial-craft masterclass, part drinks-after-court conversation, The Hunt reveals what separates good trial lawyers from great ones: getting the call.
Because every legendary career leaves tracks. The Hunt follows them.

Follow The Hunt with Bethany Schneider on Spotify, Apple Podcasts or wherever you get your podcasts.

About our Host:
Bethany Schneider is the founder of Schneider Injury Law and a trial attorney with more than a decade of courtroom experience across Georgia and Florida.

After nearly nine years handling complex, multimillion-dollar products liability litigation at international defense firm King & Spalding, Bethany founded Schneider Injury Law in 2018. Since then, she has won more than $80 million for injured clients and built a reputation for powerful storytelling in the courtroom.

Bethany knows how to try cases. Now she’s focused on understanding how trial lawyers get the opportunity to try the ones that define their careers.

About Schneider Injury Law:
Schneider Injury Law is an all-female boutique trial firm based in Atlanta, Georgia, representing people and families affected by catastrophic injuries and wrongful death, focusing predominantly on commercial vehicle/truck accidents, birth injuries/maternal deaths, and sexual assault.

At the center of the firm’s identity is the lioness—an emblem of strength, protection, and determination that reflects the firm’s guiding philosophy:
Compassionate Counselor. Tough Advocate.

That same spirit drives The Hunt: the pursuit of justice, excellence, and the opportunity to make a difference when it matters most.

title: Inishowen Music
author: Neil McGrory
description:
Inishowen Music

A Podcast Series about the archival

work of Inishowen Traditional Music Project


Founded in 1999 Inishowen Traditional Music Project (ITMP) has been deeply involved in collecting, recording and developing the traditional music of the Inishowen peninsula in County Donegal, Ireland.

It has built up an extensive archive of music recordings, manuscripts, photographs, film and other materials. In 2026 ITMP has received funding from The Heritage Council to develop and protect the archive by upgrading the cataloguing and digital preservation of the material, along with a conducting a website upgrade which is currently in progress.

This podcast series explores the ideas behind the archiving of traditional music along with three episodes dealing with three of the main figures in the collection.


Episode 1: Thursday 12th November 2026

Why Archive ?

an overview of the Archive of Inishowen Traditional Music Project


This is the first episode of a four part series.

In this instalment, co-founder of Inishowen Traditional Music Project and fiddle player Roisin McGrory talks about the beginnings of the project, along with the reasons behind the need for archiving the music of the peninsula.


This episode also includes discussions with Caoimhin Mac Aoidh and Conor Caldwell about their work with Cairdeas na BhFidiléirí and the importance of music archiving.

Archivist and singer Grace Toland will also give an overview into the role and the organisation of archives, and her work on the cataloging and organisation to ITMP’s archives.

Composer and musician Paul Harrigan talks about the interactive learning resources he developed for ITMP.


Episode 2: Thursday 26th November 2026

Honoria Galwey (1830-1925) - a forgotten collector.

ITMP has since 2016, been exploring and developing the study of this important female collector who collected in and around Moville in the mid to late1800s.

In 2025 ITMP commissioned a documentary film Between Two Worlds - Honoria Galwey- A Portrait.

This film included historical research along with a new arrangement of tunes and songs from her collections. Also included was recently uncovered material, which was discovered during the research for the project.


Episode 4. 12th December 2026

Seamus Grant (1934-2005)

ITMP recorded Seamus’s one and only commercial recording.

ITMP’s archive holds a wealth of archive material relating to this important fiddler.

This episode will explore Seamus’s legacy as a fiddle player through interviews with musicians who played with Seamus and an overall perspective on his position within the tradition.


Episode 4. 23rd December 2026

Dinny McLaughlin (1935-2004)

ITMP worked with this noted musician, composer, poet and choreographer on many projects over the years prior to his death.

He was the main focus of Féile na hInse 2026 which took place in April.

This episode will explore the wealth of material that ITMP holds relating to Dinny from recordings, stories, poetry and photographs. It has a substantial collection of material shot during the production of the documentary Ark of Tides (2013) which it would like to make available to the public.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

Ever wondered what a chef notices when they sit down to eat? The answer is: everything.

Join chefs and friends Dara Klein, founder of Tiella Trattoria and Bar, and Diarmuid Goodwin, who trained under Angela Hartnett, as they delve into Time Out’s Top 2% restaurant list, in paid partnership with Chase, to discover some of the city’s most delicious corners. From longstanding neighbourhood joints to high-end restaurants you’ve always wanted to try, the duo indulge at London’s best eateries, one plate at a time.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Plywood Boardroom
author: Tony Schneider
description: Two sawhorses, a sheet of plywood, and the board meeting’s in session. Pull up a bucket. On The Plywood Boardroom, contractors who run small crews swap stories about keeping the bookkeeper off their back, getting everybody paid, and trying to make a few bucks themselves. First order of business: who told the homeowner we could squeeze that in? From the folks behind PlanCrAI.

title: Delusionally Speaking
author: Charlotte Barson
description: A long time lover, consumer and critic of all things Bravo, Pop Culture, Reality TV, and Celerity Lure! Join me for my weekly pop culture deep dives, reality tv recaps, and Celebrity episodes. Who will be awarded the delulu of the week? Check out Delusionally Speaking to find out! Aren't we all a little delusional...

title: She Rises Through It: Self-Leadership, Becoming & Growth for Women in Transition
author: Cydnie Brown
description:
She Rises Through It is a weekly podcast for women who are navigating the messy middle of growth; where identity shifts, motivation fades, and the next chapter hasn’t fully revealed itself yet.


I’m Cydnie Jocelyn, Minnesota-based CEO of The Cydnie Jocelyn Collective, retreat creator, and mentor for women in transition. This podcast is where I speak honestly about becoming in real time, without bypassing the discomfort, the nervous system work, or the real-life responsibilities we’re carrying alongside our growth.


Here, we don’t chase quick fixes or perform healing.
We build self-leadership, slowly, intentionally, and with integrity.


Each episode explores:
 • self-leadership in seasons of transition and growth
 • burnout, misalignment, and rebuilding self-trust
 • identity shifts, becoming, and the space between who you were and who you’re becoming
 • nervous system regulation and emotional resilience
 • motherhood, leadership, and capacity-building in real life
 • the discomfort before expansion and how to lead yourself through it


This podcast is for women who are doing the work, parenting, leading, healing, building, while quietly feeling that something in their life is changing. Women who are ready to stop waiting for permission and start trusting themselves again.


Alongside the podcast, I host transformational retreats in Minnesota and Costa Rica, offer identity mentorship, and cultivate spaces where women can slow down, regulate their bodies, and reconnect to their inner authority before expanding into what’s next.


If you’ve ever felt stuck between who you were and who you’re becoming, this space is for you.


You’re not behind.
You’re not broken.
You’re building self-leadership in the messy middle.


Welcome to She Rises Through It.

title: She Gets Me
author: Veronica Coverson and Alex Labanca
description:
There’s nothing quite like finding that friend who just gets you. But choosing each other through different seasons of life? That’s a whole other story. 
We’re sharing what it’s like to grow up together without growing apart. How we navigate conflict, extend compassion, and show up for each other even when we don’t fully understand. 
We’re letting you in on our voice memo updates and after bedtime chats. Sharing what God is teaching us, to dating, marriage, motherhood, potty training, and the occasional roasts. You’ll hear it all, nothing is off limits. 
Welcome to She Gets Me!

title: PILOT: WELCOME TO THE UNRAVELING
author: Unraveling the Inner Return
description:
Unraveling the Inner Return | Episode 1

What happens when everything you’ve learned about spirituality begins to unravel?

In this pilot episode, I introduce Unraveling the Inner Return, exploring why unraveling spiritual conditioning is essential as we move from accumulated knowledge into authentic embodiment.

Drawing from three decades of spiritual development, I reflect on the journey through Metatronic systems, Guardian and Freedom Teachings, and the deeper recognition of the KRYSTIC architecture. We explore spiritual overlays, distorted narratives, discernment, and the organic path of restoration and reconnection with our Oversoul consciousness.

This isn’t about replacing one belief system with another. It’s about questioning what we’ve inherited, recognizing our own inner authority, and moving beyond spiritual dependency into conscious embodiment.

Whether you’re already walking the KRYSTIC path or beginning to question conventional spiritual narratives, you’re welcome to join the conversation.

title: Sons of Issachar
author: Paul Kidder and Jared Nield
description: Do you know the times you are in? The Sons of Issachar did and that is our aim as well. We discuss Biblical topics as they are relevant to our world today as well as deep dives on history of the Church.

title: The White Phoenix Archives: Bridging the Human and the Numinous
author: ILEANA A RONTEA
description:
The White Phoenix Archives: Bridging the Human and the Numinous explores consciousness, anomalous experiences, and the mysteries of reality.
Hosted by Ileana A. Rontea, founder of PhoenixOnTheRise.com and creator of the White Phoenix Method, the podcast features conversations with experiencers, researchers, and consciousness explorers.
Drawing on over three decades of professional experience, including Cognitive Analytic Therapy (CAT) and HRM (CIPD), Ileana brings a grounded approach to extraordinary experiences, emphasizing discernment, psychological balance, and personal sovereignty.

title: The Whiners Podcast
author: Dr. Diane Miliken Garza
description: A podcast where, over a glass of wine, women discuss life and how hard it is | Hosted by Dr. Diane Miliken Garza, CEO of the Rio Grande Valley Philanthropic Foundation

title: Off Script with Anna the Pharmacist
author: Anna Theophilos
description:
Off Script with Anna the Pharmacist is hosted by pharmacist Anna Theophilos. Through engaging stories, expert conversations and practical insights, Anna unpacks the science shaping our health and what it means at the pharmacy counter and in everyday life.
For pharmacists, healthcare professionals and anyone curious about their health. Bring your questions. Let’s go Off Script.
Follow Anna for more information:
Website - https://annathepharmacist.com.au
Instagram - htps://instagram.com/thevaccinationpharmacist
LinkedIn - https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-theophilos-6a5a89231

title: The Guest List with Louise Parker
author: Hot Dance Radio Ibiza
description:
The Guest List, hosted by Louise Parker, is the show that takes you beyond the booth and into the people, places and stories shaping Ibiza. From the tracks that changed everything to the hidden corners, personal rituals and unexpected moments that make the island feel like home, Louise sits down with DJs, producers, founders and creative voices to discover what Ibiza looks like through their eyes.
Follow the show @theguestlistishere on Instagram.
Follow our host @thelouiseparker.

title: One Thing at a Time - Explore with Ayesha
author: Ayesha
description:
A little space to think, reflect and figure things out.
A solo podcast about life, personal growth, habits, mindset, everyday struggles and everything in between.
Through honest conversations, we explore the thoughts we sometimes keep to ourselves and the lessons we learn the hard way.
No interviews. No expert lectures. No promises of overnight transformation.
Just one voice, a few honest thoughts, different perspectives and an invitation to figure things out together.
Because none of us has everything figured out.
Life is a lot. Let's take it one thing at a time.
New episodes every week.

title: Fangirl Files
author: Cailyn Hoertz
description: Cailyn is a self-proclaimed professional fangirl and lifelong fan of many, many people and things. In Fangirl Files she discusses her personal and professional experience in fan culture as well as deep dives into specific fandoms and internet niches in an effort to show the importance of fan communities. All this with a "friend on facetime" feel of casual chatter, funny bits, and real connection.

title: Be Well. Be Beautiful Podcast by Eco Chic
author: bewellbebeautifulbyecochic
description: Host Michele Maestri launches Be Well Be Beautiful Podcast by Eco Chic. Covering special guests with very unique methods to maintain a healthy lifestyle. In this episode Michele talks with Agnieszka Szablonska from AUM Well Being. They dive into High-performance Light Therapy which harmonizes the human body’s energy using precisely calibrated color frequencies and sound waves,  this method is called LuminETHERAPY.

title: School Of Experience Podcast
author: Sam
description:
Welcome to the School of Experience Podcast with Sam.
Life is a classroom, and experience is one of its greatest teachers.
On this podcast, Sam explores the lessons hidden inside real-life experiences — the mistakes, successes, setbacks, relationships, opportunities, failures, and moments that shape who we become.
Expect honest conversations, practical wisdom, personal stories, and thought-provoking discussions designed to help you see life differently and learn from experiences — yours and those of others.
No perfect answers. No pretending. Just experience, lessons, and growth.
🎙️ School of

title: Deeper Dating Podcast
author: Ken Page, LCSW
description: Finding love isn’t about gimmicks or games. It’s about something far more profound than we’ve ever been taught. In this podcast by renowned psychotherapist and bestselling author Ken Page, you’ll learn the most effective, research-backed tools for transforming the way you date -- and finding authentic love.

title: One Too Many Loads Pt. 2, Presented by Jeff
author: Jeffrey E. Puddhingkup
description: Jeffrey Puddhingkup and Pepper signed off on a contract with a local podcasting production company and officially begin their monetized shenanigans!

title: Killah Priest Podcraft
author: Killah Priest
description: Killah Priest Podcast takes listeners beyond the music and into the mind of one of hip-hop’s most thought-provoking lyricists. Known for his Wu-Tang affiliation, spiritual wisdom, and powerful storytelling, Killah Priest explores hip-hop culture, music, spirituality, life experiences, and meaningful conversations that inspire deeper thinking. Raw, authentic, and enlightening, this is more than a podcast—it’s a journey through knowledge, creativity, and consciousness.

title: Here’s Something I Remember
author: Brian Farvour
description: A podcast about the little things, the nostalgia, and the stories about each that have shaped my life.  Take a listen if you like hearing about defunct food, forgotten restaurant chains, my own ideas for movies long since abandoned and the childhood memories at the core of it all.

title: Good Morning, Sunshine!
author: Tiffany Davis
description:
Emotional Intelligence & Mindfulness for Kids and Families
Good Morning, Sunshine! is a joyful, screen-free podcast helping children and parents grow emotionally, build resilience, and connect through kindness.
Through playful stories, uplifting songs, breathing exercises, and positive affirmations, children learn to understand their emotions, build confidence, and navigate life's little challenges.
But this podcast isn't just for kids! It's also a gentle reminder for parents to slow down, practice patience, and communicate with compassion.

title: The Adults in the Room
author: Peter
description: Procedure, polling, and the norm nobody is defending. Peter covers the machinery: committees, calendars, court rulings, polling averages, and the boring decisions that turn out to matter. No vibes, no villains, no clean answers — just an attempt to explain what actually happened and what the rules say should happen next.

title: The Heterodox One
author: Nadia
description: Brave, brittle, and one segment from a side. Nadia follows the fights about speech, campus, and institutional courage — and the quieter story of who folded and who didn't. She will say the unpopular thing, name the cowardice, and admit when she's wrong. A daily argument about the cost of being disliked.

title: The Rust Belt Hour
author: Frank
description: The plant, the shift, the paperwork. Frank reports from the floor: the line, the union hall, the grievance, the consultant who has never worked a shift. Utilities, layoffs, tariffs, and the decisions made in rooms where nobody on the line was invited. Plain talk, no irony, no journey.

title: The Byline
author: PBJ Productions
description: The Byline is a weekly, long-form video interview show about the issues that shape everyday American life — told through the journalists who have dedicated time, years, sometimes decades, to reporting them from the inside out.

title: No Wasted Chapters with Lyric Martin
author: Lyric Martin
description: Wasted Chapters with Lyric Martin brings honest conversations about fatherhood, relationships, personal growth, and rebuilding through real stories and hard-earned lessons. It’s about finding purpose in what you’ve been through and taking ownership of the chapter you write next.

title: Signal Check by Strongside
author: Strongside Strategy
description: Signal Check is a test feed from Strongside Strategy. We use it to show how a show moves from the edit bay to Buzzsprout and on to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube and the rest. Episodes here are short and mostly about the plumbing: how the feed gets set up, how artwork and show notes carry through, and how fast a new episode reaches every app. If you found this by accident, welcome. The real shows are coming soon.

title: Yesterday Never Left
author: Tight Montana
description:
History doesn’t disappear. It leaves fingerprints.

The past isn’t dead. The decisions, betrayals, wars, revolutions, and ambitions that shaped yesterday are still influencing the world we live in today.

Welcome to Yesterday Never Left, hosted by Tight Montana, where history is more than dates, names, and textbook explanations. It’s a story of power, ambition, survival, loyalty, and the human decisions that changed the course of civilization.

From George Washington and the American Revolution to Napoleon, Abraham Lincoln, Adolf Hitler, and the rise and fall of empires, we go beyond the familiar headlines to explore the people, conflicts, and circumstances that shaped our world.

Through immersive storytelling, historical research, and a perspective that blends street wisdom with intellectual curiosity, Yesterday Never Left brings history to life—one chapter at a time.

Because to understand the world we’re living in, sometimes you have to understand the world that came before it.

Yesterday Never Left. History doesn’t disappear. It leaves fingerprints.

title: Questioning Organized Religion
author: contrarymarypodcast
description: I couldn't help but feel like something was missing from my church experience. I began questioning what I had been taught and pursuing the truth.

title: Konversations with K
author: Anita
description:
Konversations with K is a space for honest, uplifting and faith-filled conversations about navigating life as a Christian woman. From marriage and motherhood to purpose, managing the home, faith, career and finding joy in the everyday, we'll explore what it means to wear many hats while keeping God at the centre.
#KonversationswithK #ChristianWomen #ChristianPodcast #FaithAndMotherhood #WomenOfFaith

title: Lux Radio Theatre
author: Golden Replay
description: American radio anthology series that broadcast live hour-long adaptations of Broadway plays and Hollywood blockbusters from 1934 to 1955

title: The Danvers Jewels (Mystery of the Missing Heirlooms)
author: Mary Cholmondeley
description:
When Colonel Middleton receives a dire request from his critically ill commander, Sir John Danvers, he has no idea that a simple task will spiral into a web of deception and intrigue. Tasked with delivering a priceless collection of family jewels from India to Ralph, Sir John’s favored nephew, Middleton soon finds himself entangled in a swirling mystery at Danvers Hall. As a lavish house party unfolds, tensions rise and hidden agendas come to light, especially when the jewels mysteriously vanish amidst amateur theatricals and whispered secrets.

In "Danvers Jewels," Mary Cholmondeley expertly weaves a tale of rivalry, suspicion, and unexpected alliances. Ralph, the seemingly innocent young man, becomes a focal point of scrutiny as his brother, Sir Charles Danvers, stands accused. Each character brings their own motives to the table, creating a rich tapestry of intrigue that keeps listeners on the edge of their seats.

What really happened to the jewels? Is Ralph truly the unwitting victim, or is he hiding a deeper connection to the crime? As clues emerge and the stakes rise, you'll find yourself questioning every character’s intentions and every twist in the plot. Join Colonel Middleton on this gripping journey through deception, family loyalty, and the true value of trust. Immerse yourself in a world where nothing is as it seems, and every revelation leads to more questions. Discover the secrets of the Danvers family and unravel the mystery that could change everything.

title: Reseller Chronicles
author: Victor Sole
description: Reseller Chronicles is where the real business of reselling gets told straight. Host Victor Sole — a lifelong New Yorker and veteran reseller — breaks down how money is actually made buying and selling used goods: where the good inventory hides, how to price it, how shipping and fees really work, and how to spot fakes before they cost you. Expect real numbers, hard lessons, and stories from the hunt, with solo breakdowns and guest resellers who do the work. No guru hype. No highlight reel. Just the chronicle.

title: Bedrock Process
author: Dan Wilson
description:
Bedrock Process is a podcast about the business side of running a company with 10 to 100 people: cash flow, the numbers that matter, the software you're paying for, and what AI can actually do for a business like yours.
I'm Dan Wilson. I build custom software and AI tools for owner-run companies. Before that I spent 14 years in the Air Force, where I ran the laboratory information systems at two hospitals.
Every episode is the audio from a video on the Bedrock Process YouTube channel, so the links and free tools I mention are in the show notes. Plain English, real numbers.
For education only. Nothing here is accounting, tax, legal or financial advice.

title: Young Money with Tracey Bissett
author: Tracey Bissett
description: This is the stuff you millionaires in the making need to know to kick start or propel you on your financial fitness journey. Tracey Bissett, Founder of Bissett Financial Fitness and award winning Financial Literacy Champion, gives you the straight goods each week to set yourself up for financial success. As a former executive at TD Bank, one of Canada's Big 5 Banks, Tracey has worked with and in support of thousands of individuals and entrepreneurs to secure the financing they needed.  This hands on experience combined with her formal financial education, Masters of Business Administration and Chartered Financial Analyst designation, position Tracey uniquely to coach all things money. Tracey goes behind-the-scenes of all the money matters with need-to-know tips, money-making demystified, and special power-player interviews. Join us weekly for Financial Fitness Training that will turn even a Cash Couch Potato into a Marathon Money Maker.

title: Webb Applications
author: Jason Webb
description: Jason Webb, self proclaimed "Me.E.O.", shares the marketing strategies he is using to grow Follow-Up Fuel, and how what he is learning can also apply to his job as D.A.D.

title: Nomad University Podcast
author: Nomad University
description: Digital Nomad's life can be very unique and fun to share! In Nomad University Podcast, you will get to listen to global digital nomads stories around the world :)

title: True Nutrition Talk with Monique Unique
author: moniqueuniquepod
description: This is an educational podcast delivering evidence-base nutrition information to the general public.  It breaks through the confusion and misinformation about food and health.

title: The Unspoken Truths of Digital Leadership
author: Jono Poon
description:
Leadership is a lifestyle choice, regardless of what title you hold, everyone is born to lead. It's just a matter of choosing to lead and making a difference to someone else's life. 

Our guests will talk about the unspoken truths of leadership, the darkside and the learnings from dealing with conflict with integrity.

title: Cosmic Girlie
author: Sage
description: Vibes are data. Sage covers the day the way it actually arrives: through the body. Moons and retrogrades, wellness, hormones, doctors who don't listen, and the strange weather of being alive right now. Dreamy, unserious, and accidentally radical — she may misread a study, but she will not invent one.

title: Live Your Truth
author: Ich Loc & Jono Poon
description:
Welcome to the Live Your Truth Podcast series, where Ich Loc and Jono Poon shed lights on some of the misinformation, half-truths, and concepts that aren't really accurate in the spiritual and personal development world.

You're not interested in hearing regurgitated content that other speakers and coaches have learned from Tony Robbins, Jim Rohn, Zig Ziglar etc. You've already heard it.

You're not interested in any of the "woo-woo" and "foo-foo" stuff either. We've all heard that, too.

And most importantly, you're frustrated and fed up with all of the fluffs and nonsense that other so-called "Gurus" are teaching, which you've applied and doesn't work.

You're interested in what actually works - what will get you real tangible results in life, and you want the Truth, so that you can create a life of freedom, love and mastery - A life with no limits!

That's exactly what Ich and Jono will be sharing with you - premises that they have discovered over the years, and have applied in their lives and in business - premises that actually work, and why they work.

So kick-back, open your mind and be prepared to be enlightened.

"Bridging Science and Spirituality together."

title: A Handle on Truth
author: Ben Everson
description: A Handle on Truth with Evangelist Ben Everson is a three-minute weekday devotional. Each episode puts a handle on one truth from God’s Word so you can carry it with you through the day. Series are drawn from Ben’s “30 Days in...” devotional books, starting with James and 1 Peter.

title: Mind Over Mistry
author: Devin Mistry
description:
Life’s messy; this is where we make sense of it.
Finding order in the chaos, one conversation at a time.
Follow along @mind.over.mistry.

title: Walk With Wolf
author: Wolf
description:
Real stories of personal transformation. I share my own journey and talk with people about the moments that changed their lives. We explore intimacy, art, altered states, and what becomes possible when we allow ourselves to change.
Take a breath, get comfortable, and walk with me for a bit.

title: The Interdimensional Traveler's Handbook
author: Rayjan Koehler
description: Join Raya Cranston on adventures of the paranormal, by way of listening to her tell us fan submitted experiences; retelling myths & Legends, and watching/hearing her interview people. Enjoy for entertainment, and keep an open mind in deciding what you believe.

title: Unsupervised Behavior
author: Teresa Michele and Jordyn Portis
description:
It's hard to raise a mother. Just ask Jordyn. 😂
Welcome to Unsupervised Behavior, the mother–daughter podcast where Teresa Michele and Jordyn Portis have plenty of opinions, hilarious disagreements, and absolutely no agreement on who's in charge.
From everyday life and random conversations to Mom vs. Teen Court, expect plenty of side-eyes, unexpected comebacks, and moments that probably should've stayed off the microphone.
Two generations. Two perspectives. Zero supervision.
New episodes every Monday!

title: Bilderbuch Deutsch
author: Dr Andreas Matthias
description:
Deutsch, das Freude macht! - Learn German the fun way! The podcast from the popular German teaching YouTube channel and Substack newsletter! Get all the episodes without the ads right here. If you'd like to watch instead, you'll find us at: https://www.youtube.com/@BilderbuchDeutsch
The newsletter is at: https://bilderbuchdeutsch.substack.com
Start your German learning journey today!

title: Better Aspects Podcast
author: Mayank Srivastava
description: The Better Aspects Podcast is a one-stop solution for all the problems you face every day while trying to get better. Here, we discuss psychology, time management, productivity, fitness, and relationship problems and provide you with tips, tricks, techniques, and ways for you to solve them in your own way.

title: KauserOS Notes
author: Mohsin Abdul Qadir
description: KauserOS Notes is a weekly podcast on AI in private markets, hosted by Mohsin Abdul Qadir. Each episode takes one question about private equity, private credit or fund operations and answers it with sourced figures: where AI spend is going, why the fund back office is the hardest AI market in finance, and who is building the private markets operating stack. New episode every Thursday, with the full written note at mohsintcs.substack.com.

title: 2 Generations 1 Mic
author: Frank Maniscalco
description: This show will talk about different topics about improving life. The hosts are father and daughter they discuss attacking different life issues from different generational viewpoints.

title: Coffee In A Mug
author: Oscar, Eddy, and Alfredo
description:
Welcome to Coffee In A Mug, the podcast started by Oscar, Eddy, and Alfredo! Three friends, one mug of coffee, and endless conversations. From everyday life and crazy stories to random topics, hot takes, and everything in between, nothing is off-limits and no conversation is ever the same.

We’re here to keep it real, have a good time, share some laughs, and enjoy every moment, one sip at a time. Whether we’re talking about serious stuff or just saying whatever comes to mind, you’re always part of the conversation.

So grab your favorite drink, sit back, relax, and join Oscar, Eddy, and Alfredo for good vibes, great laughs, and conversations that feel like hanging out with your friends.

Coffee In A Mug — Pour a cup, pull up a chair, and join the conversation. 

Follow us on Instagram @CoffeeInaMugPodcast.

title: AI Marketing Plus Podcast
author: Dane Golden and Steve Goers
description: Growth Marketing is changing fast. If you're a Growth Marketer, please subscribe to our podcast and newsletter. Each week, hosts Dane Golden and Steve Goers help you adapt to how the world of marketing is changing. We ask the industry experts about marketing-related strategy, software, AI, SaaS, tools, and platforms.

title: Smart Disha
author: Smart Disha
description: Smart Disha is a trusted platform offering innovative digital solutions and valuable resources, helping businesses and individuals simplify processes, improve efficiency, and achieve their goals with smart technology. https://smartdisha.com/

title: Mulberry Street Memories
author: Christopher
description: What we're gonna do is take you back...way back! Back to a time when the Little Italy neighborhood of New York City was a family community, based on faith and friendship. Join Vincent LaBarbera and John Bivona as they look back on their time growing up in the neighborhood from the 1940s-70s.

title: Voices Of Influence
author: Ben Jeffries & Caspar Lee
description:
Welcome to Voices of Influence, a podcast created by Influencer. In a world where creators and their audiences shape culture, and the media and advertising world is evolving faster than ever, Voices of Influence is about the people driving that change. From creators and founders to media leaders, trailblazing brands and industry insiders, these voices shape the future. Voices of Influence explores creative risks, pivotal decisions, and career-defining moments. Expect honest conversations about growth, ambition, and the shifts transforming how we connect, create, and communicate.﻿

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Kickin It Wit Cuz
author: Kickin It Wit Cuz
description: Kickin It Wit Cuz is where real conversations meet good energy. Hosted by Cuz, the show feels like kicking it with family—sharing laughs, exchanging opinions, telling unforgettable stories, and speaking honestly about life, culture, relationships, entertainment, and everything in between. Some conversations are light, while others get spirited, but nothing is forced or overly rehearsed. Whether Cuz is joined by a special guest or sharing his own perspective, expect humor, authenticity, and plenty of personality. We ain’t doing interviews over here—we just Kickin It Wit Cuz!

title: Dark Medical History
author: Mercari
description:
Step into the strange, fascinating, and sometimes unsettling world of medical history.


From terrifying surgical procedures and bizarre treatments to mysterious illnesses, groundbreaking discoveries, and experiments that pushed the boundaries of science, each episode uncovers an extraordinary story from medicine's past.


Through immersive storytelling and atmospheric sound design, we explore the people, discoveries, and darker chapters that shaped modern medicine.


Because the history of medicine is often stranger than fiction.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Healthy Life Podcast
author: keith Fentress
description:
Welcome to The Healthy Life Podcast – your destination for health, wellness, and healthy living.

Our podcast explores important topics related to physical health, mental well-being, nutrition, fitness, and everyday healthy habits.

Join us as we share useful insights, practical wellness tips, and informative discussions to help you make better choices for a healthier lifestyle.

Listen, Learn & Live Healthier!

title: In the Meantime: Short Audio Stories
author: Xperience J
description:
For the commute, the in-between, or whenever you need a quick lil story.
In the Meantime is home to short-form audio dramas from Shhh! Jus’ Listen Media, created by Xperience J. Every episode is a few minutes long. Press play and you’re in it.
Now playing: delivered., a thriller told through voice notes; side b, a mystery hidden on an old cassette; and 4AM, the late-night romance that started it all.
New stories drop regularly. Earbuds in.
For more short stories like these, follow us on Instagram @shhhjuslisten

title: Ralph Nader Radio Hour
author: Ralph Nader Radio Hour
description: Ralph Nader talks about what's happening in America, what's happening around the world, and most importantly what's happening underneath it all.

title: In the Making
author: Framework Creative
description:
Every great story starts somewhere. Welcome to In the Making, a podcast by Framework Creative!

In the Making is all about real conversations with entrepreneurs, creators, and people who are building something meaningful. We'll explore their stories, the challenges they've overcome, and what it really takes to turn an idea into reality. Join Kate and Anthony as they talk to local entrepreneurs. 

Recorded at Audio Room Seven in Brentwood, Tennessee.

🌐 Learn more about our studio: www.audioroomseven.com

title: Raise Your BARS
author: Al Ruttan & Chris Baker
description: Tune in as Chris and Al talk about life lessons, growth opportunities, and how to raise your BARS. (Previously Lead From the Drivers Seat)

title: A Meditation a Day
author: Quiet Hours
description:
A Meditation a Day: guided meditation, breathing exercises and sleep meditations for calm, relaxation and deep rest. One gentle practice at a time.
 🌅 Morning meditations and positive affirmations to begin the day with clarity
 🌬️ Breathing techniques and body scans to release tension and settle your mind
 🌙 Sleep meditations and deep relaxation to guide you gently into restful sleep
 Each episode lasts between 6 and 60 minutes, so you can choose the mindfulness practice that feels right for you today. Perfect for beginners and for anyone building a daily meditation habit. No experience needed. Just find a comfortable place, take a breath, and let the voice guide you.
 Headphones are lovely, but not required. Sleep and deep relaxation episodes are meant for lying down, never for driving or operating machinery.

title: My Generation

The Thinking Room explores leadership, life and the questions that shape how we think. Through thoughtful, unhurried conversations with leaders, founders, investors, academics, creatives and emerging voices, we explore success and failure, identity and relationships, trust, resilience and a changing world.


We make space for personal experience, different perspectives and the moments that cause us to question what we believe. Each conversation is an invitation to pause, reconsider and see something differently.


A Ratcliffe Circle series.

title: The Drum Drum Show
author: Michael Dawson
description: Join veteran drummer and journalist Mike Dawson (The Modern Drummer Podcast With Mike & Mike, Drum Candy) and fellow drummers Thomas Wendt and David Throckmorton for a weekly deep dive into all things drumming. Building on their popular “10 Reasons to Love…” series, the trio celebrates legendary drummers, revisits favorite recordings, and talks candidly about life as a working musician. Equal parts insight and humor, it’s a podcast for drummers who love listening, learning, and talking shop.

title: The Mystery of the Ravenspurs (Secrets of the Seaside Clan)
author: Fred M. White
description:
When the last of the Ravenspurs begins to vanish without a trace, the remaining family members find themselves caught in a web of intrigue and danger. The once-prosperous clan, known for their majestic seaside castle, is now haunted by a series of mysterious events that threaten to eradicate their lineage. As whispers of dark secrets and hidden enemies swirl around them, the remaining Ravenspurs must race against time to uncover the truth behind these chilling occurrences. With each member facing their own fears and suspicions, alliances will be tested, and trust will become a precious commodity.

Join the journey as a determined investigator delves deep into the family's history, unraveling clues that lead to shocking discoveries and long-buried secrets. What ancient rivalries and bitter betrayals lie at the heart of the Ravenspurs' troubles? Can the remaining heirs confront the ghosts of their past before it's too late?

In 'The Mystery of the Ravenspurs,' Fred M. White crafts a thrilling adventure filled with suspense, unexpected twists, and a quest for survival. As listeners navigate through treachery and revelation, they will be captivated by the unraveling mystery that could change the fate of the Ravenspurs forever. Prepare for a gripping tale that will keep you on the edge of your seat and craving answers until the very last moment.

title: Global Church Podcasts
author: Global
description: We are Global Church. Our Churches will always be Christ Centred, Bible Based, Spirit Led. We will always be on a mission to make disciples who Love God, Love Life & Love People, and we will continually plant churches that are Real, Relevant and Robust, aiming to touch communities from Here to Everywhere.

title: Between The Lines
author: Dami.
description:
Why do we choose what we choose—and what’s really driving us?
“Between the Lines” explores the reasons behind our choices, beliefs, opinions, and behaviour. From politics and religion to relationships, culture, identity, money, and everyday life, we question social norms, challenge assumptions, and uncover hidden motivations through honest conversations, stories, and diverse perspectives.
Because sometimes, the most interesting part isn’t what we chose. It’s why.

title: Tube City Online’s ”Two Rivers, 30 Minutes” - McKeesport, PA
author: Tube City Online - McKeesport
description: "Two Rivers, 30 Minutes" is a weekly public affairs radio show and podcast about McKeesport and the Monongahela-Youghiogheny River region. Our focus is community events, history, arts, and public affairs in the Mon Valley. The show may be heard Sundays on WEDO (810) McKeesport and WZUM (1550/101.1 FM) Braddock-Pittsburgh.

title: Electricity Bytes
author: DEATH BLADE
description: This podcast is about Electricity info like how people lost power, what happened, and the stories that people had about it, and how you can help yourself during the events of a power outage.

title: Ellis The Ledger
author: Ellis The Ledger
description: Who wanted this, who gains power, who gains money. Here's the data — you decide. (A non-partisan, numbers-first investigation of new laws and who they really serve.)

title: Fluent in Pawns
author: Fluent in Pawns
description:
Welcome to Fluent in Pawns! 
This is the home for fun, casual, and entertaining chess matches—whether I'm going head-to-head against Oscar or taking on challengers from around the world online.
From clever tactics and endgame battles to hilarious blunders and clutch comebacks, we speak the language of chess one move at a time. Grab a seat, watch the games unfold, and join the community as we climb the rating ladder together.
Hit follow so you never miss a match!
Don't Forget to follow me on 
Patreon- https://www.patreon.com/collection/2488162, Patreon Account-https://www.patreon.com/benjihaley

title: Panjcast
author: Panjea
description: Host Ollie Happy takes us behind the scenes of Panjea - the social network owned by everyone. We meet the founders, hear the origin story and take a close look at the evolution of the project.

title: UN-ATTACHED
author: Victoria Kelly Yates
description: Welcome to UN-ATTACHED—a podcast about healing the patterns that keep you stuck so you can live and love more freely. We'll explore attachment in relationships, career, success, and identity, why it all begins in our earliest experiences, and how to rewire those patterns through neuroscience, Inner Family Systems (IFS), and nervous system regulation. Expect conversations on self-connection, modern dating, limiting beliefs, attachment styles, inner child healing, and creating a life that's no longer driven by fear—but by freedom.

title: St. Paul Lutheran Tacoma Sermons
author: Pastor Hopper
description: God the Father has made all things beautiful. The world and all within it are more beautiful because of their purpose. They are made to be filled with and to proclaim the unfathomable riches of God's wisdom and power, and to participate together in his abundant life. Publicizing these sermons is one way we at St. Paul experience and share in the resurrection life of Christ our Lord, in the hope that they will fill you as well, so you too may radiate his glory into every dark corner of your life today.

title: The Impact Being Podcast
author: Dr. Tim Silvestri
description: The Impact Being Podcast connects the dots between being, doing, aligning, and thriving. Through conversations with researchers, authors, scientists, and successful people, the show explores what it takes to persevere through adversity, slow down, practice patience and discipline, and ultimately thrive.

title: The Lawyers Who Live It
author: Petrelli Previtera
description:
Short-form video podcast from Petrelli Previtera, hosted by family-law attorneys Tom Petrelli and Melinda "Mindy" Previtera: practical, funny takes on co-parenting, blending a family, and building a firm. This feed begins with the Holiday Special (12 episodes), then continues into Season 1.
For information and entertainment only. Not legal advice; listening does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state. Talk to a licensed attorney where you live.
Attorney advertising. Responsible attorney: Thomas Petrelli. Petrelli Previtera, LLC.

title: The Do Good Podcast
author: Rio Grande Valley Philanthropic Foundation
description: Highlighting the people who make the Rio Grande Valley a little better every day. Join us as we hear from different community pillars in each episode and learn about their efforts to build our community. | Hosted by Dr. Diane Miliken Garza, CEO of the RGV Philanthropic Foundation

title: Beyond The Base | Hawaiʻi
author: Kanaeokana
description:
What is it like to live in one of the most militarized places on Earth, and what would it take to change that?
Across Hawaiʻi, the U.S. military manages roughly 245,000 acres, much of it leased in the 1960s for just one dollar. After 65 years those leases are set to expire, creating a rare moment of possibility for Hawaiʻi.
Guided by Makawalu, a way of seeing through many interwoven perspectives, Beyond the Base explores how these systems took shape, what they mean for communities and what a just future might look like for Hawaiʻi.

title: The Order
author: The Order
description:
The Order is a brotherhood for men who are done living below their capacity. Former SAS operator Nico Seedsman sits down with brothers and guests to talk courage, faith, fatherhood, brotherhood and the timeless principles that make a man: loyalty, integrity, honor and responsibility. No hedonism. No excuses.
God Wills It.

title: Fusion - One Step Ahead
author: Fusion Unlimited
description: With 30 years of experience across the media landscape, we keep your brand one step ahead wherever your audience is. Get to know the digital marketing experts behind the strategies, campaigns and results that make it happen, as we share monthly insights around sectors and channels that we work across.

title: AuDSEX
author: Tynan Rhea Bramberger
description:
Living with autistic, ADHD, or AuDHD traits can be rewarding and challenging in all aspects of our lives, including sex! As an AuDHD sex and relationship therapist myself, living in an intersex body and a nonbinary gender, I know all too well how important it is to find our own unique path toward the kind of sex we actually want.

In this podcast, I will guide you through exercises to help you reflect on where you've been, where you're at, and where you want to go! Whether that includes sex in your life or simply enjoying what you find erotic in other parts of your life, my hope is that with a little self-reflection we can put down expectations and move toward a deliciously authentic life.

title: Elliott James | Unscripted: In The City
author: Elliott James | Unscripted
description: Pull up a chair and join Elliott James for the In the City Watch Party, an episode-by-episode reaction podcast from Elliott James | Unscripted. We’re talking friendships, relationships, messy decisions, and the moments that make you pause the television because we need to discuss what just happened. Expect candid commentary, strong opinions, and the occasional side-eye. Watch the episode, then come talk about it with me.

title: Burnout to Balance
author: MsJAG
description:
BURNOUT TO BALANCE | The Workplace Survival Podcast
Sick of workplace drama, impossible expectations, toxic bosses, and dreading another day at work? You’re in the right place.
Burnout to Balance takes an unfiltered look at workplace burnout, dysfunctional management, difficult coworkers, chronic stress, and the psychological toll of working in an environment that drains you.
Based on the book Burnout to Balance: Your 8-Step Guide to Thriving in a Messy Workplace, written by a veteran ICU nurse with nearly three decades of experience in high-pressure environments, this podcast brings workplace psychology and real-world experience together.
No motivational speeches. No pretending a positive attitude will fix poor management. Just an honest examination of why people burn out, how toxic workplaces operate, and what you can do to protect your mental health without sacrificing your career.
Listen to the complete audiobook right here on Spotify.
Your workplace shouldn’t cost you your mental health.

title: Living a Soul-Led Life with Kelly Palmer.
author: Kelly Palmer
description: Welcome to Living a Soul-Led Life with Kelly Palmer, where science meets spirituality and we nurture your mind, body and soul. Join Kelly, Chartered Physiotherapist, Energy Healer and Soul Mentor, for heartfelt conversations, practical wellbeing wisdom and soulful inspiration. Enjoy a little moment of calm with Soulful 60 Seconds every Monday and Soulful Conversations over a cuppa with inspiring guests. Whether you're seeking calm, clarity or a deeper connection with yourself, pull up a chair in the soulful studio. Your soul is welcome here! ✨

title: Under Review Podcast
author: Under Review
description: Talking weekly London Lions, in the SLB, SLBW, Eurocup as well as all things film including reviews, box office and industry chat

title: The Shane Marshall Podcast
author: shane.marshall
description:
Honest conversations about following Jesus in everyday life.
I’m Shane, a follower of Jesus, sober since September 1, 2023 by His grace. On this podcast, I talk about seeking Him in all things, growing in my faith, and learning more about Him each day so I can serve Him better. You’ll hear Scripture explained in plain words, real stories from my faith and recovery, and encouragement for the hard days.
Whether you’re fighting addiction, wrestling with questions about God, or just want to grow closer to Jesus, you’re welcome here. Come as you are.

title: Clearintel
author: DB
description: The purpose  is to learn from lived experiences and create a better world of abundance.

title: Macabre Daily’s SCARED SANE Podcast
author: scaredsane
description:
At Macabre Daily, we know you love horror. We take it for granted that we are drawn to horror for the screams and the scares. It burrows under our skin and hunts down our darkest fears and anxieties. It turns them against us and confirms some of our most deep-seated worries about the world around us. And we love the genre for it. We keep coming back for more. Why? 
Sometimes the answer is simple. It’s fun! Sometimes a cigar is just a cigar. Or in this case, perhaps, a knife is just a knife. But sometimes it is so much more. That is what we will explore in the new Scared Sane Podcast, launching on November 11, 2026. Joining ranks with The Macabre Daily Podcast, we are excited to create a new space to explore what makes us and our favorite genre tick. 
Every other week, Macabre Daily’s resident mental health professional, Brian Finnerty, will invite some of our favorite horror fans and creators to lie down on the proverbial therapy couch and talk about their relationship to horror and mental health. In a world where these subjects are taboo, we are excited to create a new space. One that destigmatizes them and asks whether perhaps horror doesn’t just scare us, but heals us too.

title: Ticket, Please!
author: Jacqueline
description: Welcome to the "Ticket, please" podcast where we review all different types of film with very personal opinions and a bit of rants. We review old and new, Scary and romantic and everything in between!

title: Going Grey with Greyson
author: Greyson Cohen
description: Going Grey with Greyson is sports, life, and good conversation. I’m Greyson Cohen, and every week I talk about the games I’m watching, the stories from my life, and the little things that make me laugh. It’s loose, honest, and fun, like hanging out with a friend who has strong opinions about football and a story for everything. Pull up a chair and hang out.

title: Passenger Live Sessions
author: WHCK Passenger Radio
description: Passenger Live Sessions is a weekly live-streamed music series from Passenger Radio WHCK, featuring artists from Detroit and beyond. Each episode combines a look at live music happening around the city with a professionally recorded live performance and conversation with a featured artist.

title: Lawrence in Australia
author: Lawrence Ruwoko
description: Interaction between an African in the diaspora and his worldwide experiences

title: Finance Alchemist Breaking Investment Myths
author: Launchpod Studio
description: A practical, myth‑busting show about what actually works in investing. It takes apart the stories and rules of thumb that quietly drain savings—market timing bravado, hot tips, fee blindness, chasing headlines, overtrading, and other habits that sound smart but rarely are. Through real‑world anecdotes, candid conversations with experts, and plain‑spoken explanations, it lays out how wealth is really built: steady compounding, sensible risk, low friction, and behavior that keeps you on plan. You get clear, simple mechanics instead of jargon, a better grasp of why common advice can backfire, and tools to separate signal from noise so your decisions line up with your goals rather than Wall Street folklore.

title: Sermons at First
author: First UMC Costa Mesa
description: Weekly sermons and lessons from First United Methodist Church in Costa Mesa, CA.

title: The Reporter's Notebook: Books, Journalism and Media Criticism
author: Shella Gardezi
description: The Reporter's Notebook explores the craft of long-form journalism through the books that bring important stories to life. Each episode delves into a book, examining its reporting, storytelling and investigative techniques, while opening up broader conversations about media criticism, journalistic ethics and press freedom. From the art of building a narrative to the responsibilities of the press, Reporter's Notebook takes a closer look at how journalism informs, challenges and holds power to account.

title: They Wrote the Book
author: Steven J Reese
description: Author and creator Steven J. Reese sits down with the best writers in the world to discuss the big ideas that make their books worth reading. Every conversation is filmed in person, face-to-face.

title: The Valley Buzz
author: Tim Miller
description:
The Valley Buzz is the podcast of the Lehigh Valley Beekeepers Association - Where local beekeepers, hobbyists, and honey lovers come together to share their stories, hard-won lessons, and passion for the hive.
Each episode features a conversation with a member of the beekeeping community: what's working, what isn't, what they wish they'd known at the start of their first season, Master beekeepers voice, beekeeping around the world, health conversations, and more. Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned beekeeper, pull up a chair and join the buzz.

title: Possotivity: Insights & Adventures with David Posso
author: David Posso
description:
Possotivity is a raw and inspiring journey into wholehearted living, growth, and authentic connection. Through soulful stories and deep conversations with creatives, dreamers and doers, It’s about how to live deeply, how to grow with grace, and how to make your presence a gift to the world.
Possotivity is a play on my last name Posso — which means “I can” — combined with -tivity, the energy of action and being. It’s not a blueprint or lifestyle to follow, but simply how I see the world — full of possibility, connection, potential and hope.

title: Two Generations, One Conversation
author: Official2GenerationsPodcast
description:
We are a mother-daughter podcast about Asian culture, family, faith, and the conversations people don’t usually have out loud.
We sit down across generations to talk honestly about the things that often go unspoken at home: expectations, identity, tradition, relationships, and what it means to grow up between two worlds. We don’t always agree, but we always listen.
Whether you’re a daughter trying to understand your mum, a mum trying to understand your daughter, or someone who wants to hear stories from families like yours, you’re welcome at our table.
New episodes [

title: Tea Time University
author: Tea Time University
description:
I do the research so you don't have too
Tea Time University is a solo podcast where I do some research into topics where you've always wanted to understand but never had the time (or mental energy) to Google at 2AM. Topics range from science, to pop culture, emotional theory to bizarre history. All of this steeped with humour, chaos and a place to enjoy learning. 
Grab a mug, and let's learn something together

title: AI Visibility Signals
author: AI Visibility Signals
description: AI search is reshaping how B2B buyers find vendors — and how revenue teams interpret their own pipeline. AI Visibility Signals gives B2B marketing leaders the strategic clarity and practitioner depth to act: what AI visibility means for pipeline, how consistent messaging makes or breaks it, how to bring your leadership team along, and what to do first.

title: Up North Uncut
author: Jonny Hillhouse, Cody Larkin
description:
For the very first episode of Up North Uncut, Johnny and Cody sit down with their good mate Dane to kick things off.

We introduce ourselves, talk about where we’ve come from and how we ended up doing what we do, before getting into some of our favourite memories and experiences from Cape York.


There’s plenty of hunting, fishing, camping and Cape yarns, stories from Dane’s years spent up north, some of the characters we’ve met along the way — and the story of the night we managed to put a boat on the bottom in 20 metres of water, in the middle of the ocean, in the middle of the bloody night.

Nothing scripted, nothing polished — just three mates sitting down, having a laugh, talking a bit of shit and sharing stories from a part of the world we reckon is pretty bloody special.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Bob Ross - The Joy of Painting
author: Bob Ross
description: You've seen him before. He's the soft spoken guy painting happy clouds, mountains and trees in about twenty-six television minutes, using big housepainting-type brushes and cooing soothing "you can do its" to the audience. His Joy of Painting program is the most recognized, most watched TV art show in history.

title: Bank Statements TV
author: Stacy Banks
description: Bank Statements TV with Stacy Banks. All Facts. No Refunds. Candid studio interviews with people with interesting stories, real conversations beyond the public persona about money, dating, status, reality TV, friendship, and careers.

title: Modern Marketing Made Simple | Social Media Marketing for Women Entrepreneurs to Get More Clients
author: Lori Ervin
description:
Are you a woman entrepreneur or small business owner trying to figure out how to use social media marketing to grow your business and get more clients? You're in the right place.


Welcome to Modern Marketing Made Simple, the podcast that helps women entrepreneurs simplify social media marketing, create content that connects, and build profitable online businesses without spending all day on Instagram.


Hosted by Lori Ervin, marketing strategist and founder of Level Up Marketing Co., this podcast brings you practical marketing strategies, actionable social media tips, and honest conversations about what it really takes to build and grow a small business.


From Instagram marketing and content creation to social media strategy, email marketing, lead generation, and selling online, Lori shares the strategies and insights you need to market your business with confidence. You'll learn how to attract your ideal audience, turn followers into paying clients, build a recognizable personal brand, and create a marketing strategy that actually supports your business goals.


You'll also hear conversations with small business owners and entrepreneurs who share their real experiences, the marketing strategies that have worked for them, the challenges they've faced, and the lessons they've learned along the way. These aren't just inspirational business stories. They're opportunities to learn practical strategies you can apply to your own business.


Whether you're building a service-based business, growing a product-based brand, or navigating the world of social selling, you'll walk away with fresh ideas, simple marketing strategies, and the confidence to put them into action.

Because growing your business shouldn't require complicated marketing strategies, constantly chasing social media trends, or spending every waking hour creating content.


Let's make modern marketing simple and help you turn your content into clients.

title: Dumb Money with Dave Peters
author: Dave Peters
description:
A journey begins into financial independence. Bon Voyage! Join financial adviser or finacial advisor (he's not sure of the spelling) Dave Peters. A man with 25 years in the business of making other people money. Now in audio form! He is an expert on everything and you can ask him your questions via email via his email address: dave@dumbmoneyshow.com.
Let Dave be your guide into the rough seas of personal finance.

title: Pistill's Saga - Written By Jay Swords
author: Jay Swords
description: Pistill's Saga - A spoken-word project by author, retired educator, radio talk-show/podcast host and historian Jay Swords.

title: Throne and Treasury: The Podcast
author: Throne and Treasury
description: Full-length history documentaries in audio: how empires rose, ruled and fell, and the money, laws and people behind them. From Sumer and Rome to Byzantium, the Ottomans and the great fortunes of the modern age. Researched and sourced; narration uses an AI-generated voice. Watch the video versions on YouTube: Throne and Treasury.

title: Insomnisounds
author: Priscilla F
description:
Welcome to Insomnisounds where we help soothe you to sleep and keep you uplifted! Enjoy our sleep sounds, lo-fi beats, positive affirmations and guided meditation. 
This is a woman-owned independent project made with love and empathy. Your continued support is always greatly appreciated!
Best enjoyed with headphones on 🎧
https://bio.site/insomnisounds

title: Too many things to mention
author: Todd
description: Things! Things to be done. Things to be done not just by anyone. Things! Things to be done. Too many things to mention

title: Podcasting For Democracy
author: Bart Sullivan
description:
Podcasting for Democracy explores how podcasts can strengthen democracy by creating space for informed conversation, diverse voices, civic participation, and community connection.
Each episode brings together people who are using podcasting to make democracy more accessible, inclusive, and engaging—from independent creators and community organizers to journalists, educators, advocates, and everyday citizens. We’ll explore the challenges facing our democracy, the power of storytelling, and the ways audio can help people listen, learn, participate, and take action.

title: Different by Design
author: Zach Gray
description:
Different by Design is a show about people who chose to build their lives on purpose.


Hosted by Zach Gray, founder of Rooted Wealth Advisors, each episode sits down with business owners, builders and community leaders from Williamson County, Tennessee and beyond. We talk about leadership, the decisions, the faith, the family and the hard seasons behind a life built differently, and what the rest of us can learn from them.


Where extraordinary people connect. New episodes every Thursday.


Watch full episodes on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@DifferentbyDesignPod


Investment advisory services provided by Rooted Wealth Advisors. Investing involves risk, including possible loss of principal. This content is for informational purposes only and should not be construed as personalized advice. Consult a qualified professional before implementing any strategy.

title: Last Shift
author: Voyage Media
description:
William Fichtner (Heat, Prison Break, Black Hawk Down) stars as a career cop who gets the chance to be a police chief, and attempts, against the odds, to improve policing in his department... one shift at a time. Based on real stories of former police chief Mike Geier. Each episode is one shift. This is The Pitt in a police station.

Based on Mike's book The Blue Journey: Memoirs Of A Cop's Cop, available on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0C7B78ZB6?lv=shuf&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback

title: Full Tank No Filter
author: Full Tank No Filter
description:
The fuel industry keeps America moving, but behind every delivery, customer call, and last-minute fuel emergency, there's a story worth telling.
Welcome to Full Tank No Filter, the podcast where fuel brokers Tahd, Kimbruh, and Big Daddy J bring humor, real-life experiences, and completely unfiltered conversations to the microphone.
From the daily chaos of fuel brokerage to hilarious workplace moments and unexpected personal stories, these three prove that even in a serious industry, there's always room for laughter.

title: The Two Minds Pod
author: Colin Owen and Steven Maxwell
description: Colin Owen and Steven Maxwell are the two directors of All Seasons Group, a family M&E business they took from £2m to £27m. Two Minds is the two of them on building, backing, and selling businesses: the calls that paid off, the ventures that didn’t, how they pick people, and what it all costs. Two very different starts, one business, and the honest version of how it grew. New episodes every other Thursday.

title: Tennis Ace
author: Tennis Ace
description: Dive into the world of professional tennis with expert analysis, player interviews, and match breakdowns. Perfect for fans who love the game.

title: To Freedom
author: Marina Theron-Monnery
description: Welcome to To Freedom, a podcast about healing, transformation, and the many paths people take toward living a freer, more authentic life. Hosted by Marina Theron-Monnery, author of FROM SURVIVAL TO FREEDOM, each episode features honest conversations with guests from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and belief systems as they share the challenges they faced, the turning points that changed them, and what freedom means to them today. Because there is no single path to freedom—only the one that is true for you.

title: More Than The Story
author: Nadia Dinneen & Travis Cartwright
description:
Welcome to More Than the Story, a podcast sharing real people, real experiences and real-life journeys.
Hosted by Nadia Dinneen and Travis Cartwright, we explore the stories behind the people, the challenges they’ve faced, the battles they’ve fought, the obstacles they’ve overcome and the experiences that have shaped their lives.
From mental health and addiction to trauma, loss, illness, adversity, resilience and personal triumph, we have honest, meaningful and sometimes difficult conversations that go beyond the surface.
Our aim is to provide a safe, supportive and non-judgemental space where people can share their experiences, raise awareness, break down stigma and remind others that they are not alone.
Because there is always more to someone than what we see, and sometimes sharing a story can change the way someone sees their own.

title: The Deal
author: Solo Media
description: The Deal is a weekly podcast about the art of the deal. Every Tuesday, hosts Alex and Jordan break down one real negotiation tactic — salary talks, buying a car, haggling with contractors, closing a client — with acted-out scenarios and a clear takeaway you can use the same day. Five minutes, one tactic, no fluff.

title: With Love, Solé
author: Solé
description: Self Mastery. Energy. Spiritual Revolution.

title: Grown Men Talk
author: K Lifestyle Productions
description: Real conversations about manhood, fatherhood, brotherhood, and growth. Join Vino, Dr. Kimble, Frankie B, and Coach as they share lived experiences and challenge what it means to be a grown man. Season 1 explores identity, family, money, and legacy. Created and executive produced by Jonathan Kimble. A K Lifestyle Productions podcast.

title: Sacred & Strange
author: Jess
description:
Spirituality, scripture, science and the supernatural were never meant to be separated. Sacred & Strange explores the hidden threads of cosmic connections. Just the courage to unlearn and discover your own truth.

Cover art photo provided by Ýlona María

Rybka on Unsplash: https://unsplash.com/@yloryb?utm_source=spreaker&utm_medium=referral

title: Aligned by Design
author: Shannon and Jonathan Badger
description:
Most businesses don't stall because they lack ideas. 


They stall because the person dreaming it up and the person building it aren't on the same page.

Jonathan and Shannon Badger know that tension well. They're married, they run Badger CPA in San Antonio, Texas together, and one of them is the visionary while the other is the operator. Aligned by Design is where they get honest about what it takes to make that work.

Each week they dig into the stuff that turns a promising company into a lasting one: clear strategy, solid systems, and the right structure behind it. Along the way they talk with founders, operators, and leaders who have scaled without burning everything down. And they'll share plenty from their own partnership, including the parts most couples in business keep quiet about.

If you've got the vision and you're ready to make it real, start here.

New episodes every week.

title: My Father And Me
author: David Devine
description: My Father And Me is a selection of poems about our relationship and his enduring legacy as well as humorous and interesting poems that he enjoyed and the ones I’m certain he would have enjoyed. Hope you like them.

title: No Beef
author: Andrew & Steve
description:
Join best friends Andrew Roberts and Steven Williams each week as they dive into all things veganism, current affairs and everything in between.


From sharing their biggest beef of the week to tackling common challenges and misconceptions around veganism, no topic is off the table.


Expect honest conversations, plenty of laughs and the occasional heated debate!

title: Structure First: Business Systems, Strategy and Getting It Done
author: Shelly Shulman
description: Structure First is for business owners who know what needs doing but can’t work out where to start, or keep starting and never finishing. I’m Shelly Shulman, and after 20 years of running businesses, from a wedding cake studio to helping owners online and off, I’ve learned that growth doesn’t fix a messy business. Structure does. Each week I talk through the strategy, systems and decisions that make a business make sense, whether you sell online, offline or both. No hype and no one-size-fits-all advice, just what matters, why it matters and how to get it done.

title: Confessions of a Medicine Woman
author: Maria Gingras
description: Healing doesn't live in perfection. It lives in the TRUTH. I'm a Registered Nurse & a medicine woman. A shamanic practitioner, an intuitive medium, a woman who has fallen apart & rebuilt herself from the ashes- many, many times. And here's what I know: the most powerful medicine I carry isn't found in a ceremony or a chart. It's found in being fully, unapologetically HUMAN. Vulnerability & authenticity are two facets of my embodied medicine. When I speak my truth, the messy, the sacred, the heartbreaking, & the holy, I give you permission to speak yours. And that's WHY this show exists.

title: Socrates: An Examined Life
author: Edward Mullen
description:
Socrates has spent a lifetime asking questions that powerful men would rather leave unanswered.


Long before the trial that would make him immortal, he was a son struggling against the life his parents imagined for him, a soldier who fought beside his fellow Athenians, a husband and father, and an unlikely teacher whose conversations drew some of the most ambitious young men in Athens to his side.


As Athens rises, wages war, tears itself apart, and struggles to rebuild, Socrates continues to challenge those around him to examine what they believe.


Yet those same questions, and his unwavering commitment to the principles by which he lived, would ultimately put his life in jeopardy.


When Socrates is brought before an Athenian jury, he must defend himself against charges of corrupting the youth and dishonouring the gods of the city. His accusers want him dead.


Socrates: The Examined Life is a historical novel about the man behind the philosophy, the city that condemned him, and the choices that transformed an ordinary citizen of Athens into one of the most influential figures in history.
