“An actual Play Homebrew Dungeons and Dragons Podcast”

“Greetings Everyone and Welcome to Veins of Lore! I’m Brian Judge & I am your Dungeon Master!”

Welcome to our home brew world of Chasmar, 41 years in the making. Full of lore and magic, Gods and Dragons and species familiar and Unique.

I am joined by

My Much more beautiful and better Half Kelsey Middaugh as “Nya Ladyre”  Who is our new blood to D&D

Mike Auriemma as “Ceahcyl Mortesta” in the Main story and "Grhym" for "Rise of the Illgaard" a long-time player of 20+ years

As well as Tim Morgan as “Ulfar the Hexed” in the Main story and "Zaaranth" for "Rise of the Illgaard" another longtime player with 30+ years experience

Joining us for "Rise of The Illgaard" Marc Graff as "Zelus" With 30+  years experience 

 We are a group of lifelong friends that have decided to bring our homebrew world and the experience of every edition of Dungeons & Dragons from Advanced D&D -2014 5e. We are based for the podcast on 2014 5e but we use rulings and calls from every edition we have played through. As well as have many homebrew traditions and rules we bring to the table. The Red House Mystery by A. A. Milne.  
Author A. A. Milne is best known to the world as the creator of Winnie-the-Pooh. Yet Milne was versatile, having written dozens of plays, humorous articles, books and – The Red House Mystery. In which…  
Mark Ablett is the massively narcissistic owner of The Red House, a beautiful English country mansion. The estate is managed mostly by Mark’s side-kick and younger cousin, Cayley. As a wealthy artiste, Mark has chosen his handful of guests both to pander to his self-image and to allow him near-total control of virtually all aspects of his luxurious country house “show,” as it were.  
In the novel’s first eight hours, Milne presents a literary tour-de-force: first, the unexpected arrival (after 15 years’ absence) of Robert, Mark’s n'ere-do-well brother from Australia; second, Robert’s murder; and third, Mark’s own disappearance. Enter Antony Gillingham, our brilliant but modest gentleman sleuth. He arrives on a passing visit to his young friend Bill, one of Mark’s house guests, who later becomes the faithful “Watson” to Antony’s Holmes. Follows the juxtaposition of three distinct theories of the crime (or perhaps, given Mark’s disappearance, crimes) as put forward by Antony, by Mark’s confidant, Cayley, and by local police Inspector Birch. It is of course Antony, with Bill’s help, who solves this this delightful and extremely well-crafted mystery.

description:
The McDonald's Empire: How Ray Kroc Built a Global Brand

McDonald's is one of the most recognizable fast-food brands in the world, serving millions of customers across different countries. But behind its golden arches is a fascinating business story involving ambition, innovation, competition, and an extraordinary vision. This podcast explores how Ray Kroc transformed a small hamburger restaurant into one of the most successful global business empires.

The story begins in 1940, when two brothers, Richard and Maurice McDonald, opened a restaurant in San Bernardino, California. They introduced an innovative system that focused on speed, simplicity, affordability, and consistency. Their approach changed the way people experienced fast food.

Years later, Ray Kroc, a milkshake machine salesman, discovered their restaurant and recognized its enormous business potential. Instead of simply selling equipment, he envisioned something much bigger: a restaurant system that could operate successfully across America and eventually around the world.

Across two episodes, we explore Kroc's entrepreneurial journey, his partnership with the McDonald brothers, the challenges of expansion, the importance of franchising, and the business strategies that made McDonald's a global name.

This is more than a story about hamburgers. It is a lesson in branding, business innovation, leadership, and the power of thinking beyond a single location.

description: Navigating adulthood, one Monday morning at a time with Janine Between the Beans and Tedededario! If you need an escape from work, school, or other responsibilities, look no further! Take us with you to work, who freaking cares... Just join us every first Monday of the month for captivating conversations with guest appearances from all walks of life. We promise we'll take you on a ride you will never forget.

title: M Project | Painter & Decorator
author: M Project | Painter & Decorator
description: *M Project* ( https://mproject.ie/ ) is a premier Dublin-based building contractor specializing in complete home renovations, turnkey refurbishments, and reliable property maintenance. From full-scale structural transformations to precision interior upgrades—including professional spray painting, flooring installation, and kitchen countertop replacements—our expert team handles every detail from concept to key handover. Driven by superior craftsmanship, clear communication, and strict adherence to timelines and budgets, we create modern, stylish, and highly functional living spaces tailored to your needs.

title: B-Side Believer
author: Jeremy Lamb
description: Every episode is a trial with one argument: the album you skipped is better than the album you worship. The famous record gets a fair hearing first — then host Jeremy Lamb makes the case for the deep cut: the ignored follow-up, the murky double album, the masterpiece hiding in plain sight. Every trial includes Check the Credits (the sidemen and producers who actually made the music) and Amnesty (where the prosecution's album gets its due). New trials weekly.

title: Remembered - Debbie Keever Ministries 2026
author: remembered
description:
What We Remember Shapes How We Live.

Join us for the Ocean City Tabernacle's Off-Season Ladies' Bible Study beginning on Friday, September 18th, 2026.
10am-11:30am.

We will  be digging deeply into the truths that shape our lives—remembering who God is, remembering who we are in Him, and remembering that He has a purpose and plan for our lives. Because what we choose to remember doesn’t just shape how we see our past—it changes how we live today and how we step into tomorrow.

title: If You Want to be Wealthy & happy
author: GrindBuddy
description:
​In this inspiring episode, we explore the essential foundations for achieving true prosperity, success, and happiness throughout life. The audio highlights that income and wealth do not exceed our personal development: to have more, we must first grow from within, because success is not something you chase, it is something you attract through inner transformation.  
​Throughout the broadcast, three crucial steps are presented to drive profound change in your life, personality, and lifestyle:  
​1. Find out how things work: The importance of fueling curiosity, reading daily for at least 30 minutes, and becoming self-educated to gain ideas that transform reality.  
​2. Go to work and take action: The value of self-discipline, starting with small habits that prepare an individual to handle life's major challenges.  
​3. Observe and learn: The wisdom of paying attention to the world, learning from the experiences of others—whether positive or negative—and using both physical vision (observation) and mental vision (insight) to guide your choices.
